Container.Name: Career-OS
Container.Overview: Career OS - a local-first job-hunting dashboard. It reads and writes an Obsidian vault (plain Markdown) as its datastore, scores and tailors job applications with a local Ollama model (or the optional Anthropic Claude API), and serves a web board on port 8787. Bind-mount your Obsidian vault to /vault. Local-only by design - nothing is exposed to the internet.
Container.Description: Career OS - local-first job-hunting dashboard backed by an Obsidian vault. Set "Vault" to your Obsidian vault path on the server (mounted at /vault). If you run Ollama, point OLLAMA_URL at it - host.docker.internal:11434 reaches the Unraid host. Leave ANTHROPIC_API_KEY blank for fully local operation.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the dashboard (maps to container port 8787).

Config.Name: Vault (Obsidian)
Config.Description: Path on the server to your Obsidian vault. Mounted read-write at /vault.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: URL of your Ollama server for local scoring/tailoring. host.docker.internal:11434 reaches the Unraid host; or use http://<server-ip>:11434 if Ollama runs in another container.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_MODEL
Config.Description: Ollama model used for scoring/tailoring.

Config.Name: ZEIL_EMAIL
Config.Description: ZEIL job-seeker account email. Needed to search ZEIL (also add 'zeil' to the sites list in Career/Profile/job-search.md). Leave blank to disable ZEIL.

Config.Name: ZEIL_PASSWORD
Config.Description: ZEIL account password (used for AWS Cognito SRP sign-in to mint a short-lived token). Leave blank to disable ZEIL.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Enables cloud Claude scoring. Leave blank for local-only (Ollama).

Config.Name: SCORING_MODEL
Config.Description: Claude model for scoring + keyword extraction (only used if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set). Haiku is ~5x cheaper than Opus.

Config.Name: USD_TO_NZD
Config.Description: USD to NZD rate for the dashboard cost estimate.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the daily scheduler (IANA name, e.g. Pacific/Auckland).

Config.Name: INGEST_SOURCE
Config.Description: graph | imap | file. 'file' parses .eml/.txt alert files from the Inbox path.

Config.Name: INBOX_DIR
Config.Description: Folder scanned for alert files when INGEST_SOURCE=file. Matches the Inbox mount target.

Config.Name: GRAPH_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Microsoft Graph: Azure AD app client ID (only if INGEST_SOURCE=graph).

Config.Name: GRAPH_TENANT_ID
Config.Description: Microsoft Graph: Azure AD tenant ID.

Config.Name: GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Microsoft Graph: Azure AD client secret.

Config.Name: GRAPH_MAIL_FOLDER
Config.Description: Mail folder your job-alert emails are filtered into (Graph).

Config.Name: IMAP_HOST
Config.Description: IMAP host (only if INGEST_SOURCE=imap).

Config.Name: IMAP_PORT
Config.Description: IMAP port.

Config.Name: IMAP_USER
Config.Description: IMAP username (email address).

Config.Name: IMAP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: IMAP app password.

Config.Name: IMAP_FOLDER
Config.Description: IMAP mail folder.

Config.Name: SCHEDULE_ENABLED
Config.Description: Auto-run the read-side pipeline daily (true|false).

Config.Name: SCHEDULE_TIME
Config.Description: Local time (HH:MM) for the daily auto-run.

Config.Name: Inbox (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Folder for .eml/.txt job-alert files when INGEST_SOURCE=file. Leave blank to skip.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Rotating app log (career-os.log + archives). Mount to a host path to keep logs across container recreation.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent app config folder (also holds the Career OS logo at /app/config/logo.png). Bind-mounting this hides the image's baked copy, so seed the host folder from the image if you rely on files here.

Config.Name: LOG_VERBOSE
Config.Description: Verbose diagnostics (timings, scorer path, convert details). 1=on, 0=high-level only.

Config.Name: LOG_MAX_BYTES
Config.Description: Rotate the log file when it reaches this size in bytes. Default 5 MB.

Config.Name: LOG_MAX_FILES
Config.Description: How many rotated log archives to keep (career-os.log.1 .. .N).

Config.Name: VAULT_PATH
Config.Description: Container path to the vault. Must match the Vault mount target (/vault). Do not change.

Config.Name: REVEAL_HOST_PATH
Config.Description: Optional. The host path your vault maps to as seen from your desktop (e.g. an SMB share like \\server\appdata\career-os\vault). Lets the dashboard 'Show files' button return an openable path. Leave blank to skip.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_HOST
Config.Description: Bind address inside the container. Must be 0.0.0.0 for bridge networking. Do not change.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_PORT
Config.Description: Container listen port. Keep in sync with the WebUI Port target.
